hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys, re, os

data = json.load(sys.stdin)
ti = data.get('tool_input', {})
fp = ti.get('file_path', '')
content = ti.get('content', '')

# Only act on HTML files
if not fp.endswith('.html'):
    sys.exit(0)

# Never modify the login page or the DM tools folder
if os.path.basename(fp) == 'index.html' or '/tools/' in fp:
    sys.exit(0)

# Only full pages have a head element
if '<head' not in content.lower():
    sys.exit(0)

# Guard already present
if 'guard.js' in content:
    sys.exit(0)

GUARD = '  <!-- Auth guard - must be first, no defer/async -->\n  <script src=\"assets/js/guard.js\"></script>\n'
new = re.sub(r'(<head[^>]*>[\t ]*\n)', r'\1' + GUARD, content, count=1, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
if new == content:
    sys.exit(0)

print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'updatedInput': dict(ti, content=new)}}))
" 2>/dev/null || true
